notes: Fix stock-video framing X/Y having no visible effect. The editor preview panned the video with object-position, which does nothing when object-fit:cover already fills both dimensions exactly — i.e. a portrait stock video in a portrait (9:16) frame at zoom 1. So dragging X/Y (and small zooms) appeared to do nothing in the preview, even though the render (src/Background.tsx) applies the framing correctly via an oversized 114% element + transform:translate(X%,Y%) scale(). The three video-preview paths (backgroundTransformStyle, updateBackgroundTransformPreview, and setThumb) now mirror the render exactly — 114% element, top/left -7%, object-fit cover, transform translate(X%,Y%) scale() — so X/Y pans at any zoom and the preview is WYSIWYG with the output. The background-image preview already used translate, so it was unaffected. Verified: scene-0 video preview now shows translate(3%,4%) scale(2.05) on load (its saved values) and pans live to translate(35%,-20%) and translate(60%,0%) at zoom 1 as the sliders move; clipped correctly by .scene-preview-layer (overflow:hidden).
